checks: existing executable hash and signature checks

cache_evidence.semantics: stage bits known; phase-number meaning unvalidated

unmapped_fields.phase: Needs phase-labelled native transitions while Telos is active; dormant zero must not become phase zero.
unmapped_fields.enrage: Needs two different labelled instance enrages; distinguish current/selected enrage from best/previous enrage.
unmapped_fields.streak: Needs a labelled streak transition; neighbouring bits alone do not establish meaning.
unmapped_fields.meter: Needs displayed meter labels through a fight to establish scale, sign and resets.
unmapped_fields.freedom: No verified active-state flag. A bit or cooldown alone does not establish the state.
unmapped_fields.game_tick: No verified game-tick source. A 7.48-second read-only counter probe of client+0..0x8000 and world-state+0..0x4000 found no monotonic +1 counter with seven or more 400-850 ms intervals. The 20 ms logic clock is not substituted.
